sn47.2:2.1: “Aware” (_sampajāna_), rendered in its noun form as “situational awareness”, is linguistically similar to _paññā_, “wisdom”. However it is used in context as a pragmatic understanding, not liberating insight (see also [dn9:17.9](), [mn122:9.5]()).
sn47.2:3.3: Note that here, as elsewhere, the closing phrase is worded differently than the opening.
